remediatedDefects.summary: Eliminated asynchronous setTimeout(() => window.print(), 100) hack in ChairsideSurgeryHubModal.tsx; converted to synchronous flushSync transition with immediate window.print() and toast notification.

Demolished hardcoded financial deduction doctorGrossMarginRub: scenarioConfig.defaultPriceRub - 16000. Replaced with calculateSurgeryFinancials() consuming catalog seed costs from SURGERY_IMPLANT_SYSTEMS (Osstem, Straumann, Dentium, Nobel, Ankylos) and actual consumables.

Eliminated synthetic mock UUID fallback 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001. Extracted resolveEffectiveSurgeryPatientId() resolving honest patient IDs from activeStore, activeVisit, dashboard, and backend database.
Demolished dummy duplicate file SurgeryStudioModal.tsx (was identical alias wrapper). Replaced with direct export in ChairsideSurgeryHubModal.tsx and updated DirectSurgeryLauncher.
Decomposed ChairsideSurgeryHubModal from 512 lines down to 422 lines (under 500L ceiling) by extracting resolveSurgeryPatient.ts (47L) and SurgeryPostOpMemoSection.tsx (71L).

Enforced strictly ONE Primary CTA button (#0d9488, .surgery-primary-cta). Converted 'Норма в 1 клик', brand selector chips, FDI teeth buttons, and torque selectors to neutral secondary borders (var(--line)).
Fixed AppShell double-mount issue by registering surgery/extraction standalone hash routes in isStandaloneActive(), preventing double modal overlay.
Eliminated word clipping and ellipses on mobile screens: patient/doctor header, express protocol subtitles, and footer telemetry now wrap cleanly without truncate.
